findings.summary: Many banks say 'מחיר אחר לצעירים' but are marked 'לא בחישוב', so the cheapest account for a 24-year-old may not be the one ranked first
The index description is confusing: the reader doesn't know what to do with 'הכסף מושקע בדולרים' or 'אפשר להחזיק אותו גם דרך קרן חוץ'
It's unclear whether the 'אינפלציה' button changes the result, and whether 86,492 ₪ is what the reader would actually see or a smaller 'today's money' figure
The fee line on the selected fund card ('0% קבועים 0% משתנים 0.02% נאמן') isn't understood
Foreign funds ('אין מחיר כאן', W-8BEN, UCITS) and the many coloured tags confuse the reader or put them off, as do the 'אין נתון' brokers
The hedged fund's wide range ('בין +2,212 ל־−23,766 ₪') is confusing and feels risky
The step chart starts at 'עכשיו 79,176 ₪' (ירושלים + MTF) although the reader owns nothing yet
The bottom 'עכשיו: …' tables feel like the same lists repeated in a different order
The colours of the bars in the account list (orange, yellow, red) aren't explained well enough for the reader to match them to the legend

Practical information is missing: how to open the account and set up monthly buying, whether 7% is realistic, what happens if the dollar falls, whether פסגות is safe, and what happens when taking money out
